parameters.name: BindType
parameters.description:
The binding type. Default value: user. Valid values:

- user: bound in the common user scenario.

- lingo: bound in the Lingo scenario.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The Git platform. Valid values:

- github: GitHub platform.

parameters.name: RoleName
parameters.description:
The role name. If you specify a role name, the role is bound to the corresponding Git account. Default value: account. Valid values:

- role: bound by role.
- account: bound by account.
